item.title: Renfrew County council goes over 2026 budget
item.description: The mayors and reeves of Renfrew County went through that upper-tier level of government’s 2026 budget with a fine-tooth comb this week. County council held its budget workshop Thursday, Jan. 29 where the members were presented with a draft budget containing a proposed 7.9 percent levy increase. item.title: Ottawa snowmobilers charged with speeding in Petawawa by OPP
item.description: PETAWAWA — Two snowmobilers from the Ottawa area have been charged after Upper Ottawa Valley (UOV) Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) officers conducted a speed enforcement exercise on an Ontario Federation of Snowmobile Clubs (OFSC) trail in Petawawa. Police report that on the afternoon of Jan. 29 officers clocked the riders travelling at 80 km/h in a posted 50 km/h zone. The incident took place on […]

item.title: Ottawa Valley-filmed ‘Blue Skies on Mars’ set for January 30 release
item.description: Sci‑fi mob drama Blue Skies on Mars releases today, featuring scenes filmed in Pembroke and the Ottawa Valley.

item.title: Climateers thank Upper Ottawa Valley leaders for 2025 climate action
item.description: Local climate advocates are thanking municipalities and political leaders across the Upper Ottawa Valley for actions taken in 2025 to address climate change and environmental protection. Handmade thank-you cards created by members of the Kitchissippi–Ottawa Valley Chapter of the Council of Canadians’ “Climateers” were delivered to municipalities in Renfrew County last week. item.title: The Ottawa Valley’s tavern era and the songs that still echo today
item.description: I’m often asked about the significance and the role that local hotels played in the heritage and culture in the Ottawa Valley. I don’t have to think too hard about that as it also influenced a large part of my life and storied beginning. Some were called taverns, others hotels, later pubs; but they all had things in common. Of course, they all offered beer, wines and spirits. Some offered fine foods. Some had rooms and of course a main lounge where the […]

item.title: Pembroke Lumber Kings soar over Hawkesbury Hawks 8-3
